rows.en:
(I came to the library with
Yamashiro-sensei today.)

\p.
I never expected you to volunteer
for extra lessons.

W-well...
If I'm going to study anyway,
I want to do it properly.

I see. Then I'll live up to
your expectations.
Let's stop here for today.

You've got good instincts. Now learn to apply
what you know. Do that, and your grades
will improve dramatically.

Shall we go get something to eat, then?
You must be hungry too.
Lead the way!
(Today was a good day.)

(I came to the library with
Yamashiro-sensei today.)
I'm starving!

\p.
To think you'd want extra lessons
again and again...

You explain things so well, Sensei,
I figured I'd listen as many times as I can.

Flattery won't get you anything, you know.
...Well, fine. Let's get started.
That should do it for today.

You've gotten much better at applying what
you know. But don't get careless.
Never skip preparing and reviewing.

(I came to Griffith Park with
Yamashiro-sensei today.)
This place has a nice view.
It's my favorite spot.
Mind if I take in the view for a while?

It shouldn't be a very big city, but
looking out over it all, you can see
so many different things.
Yeah, the school, houses, parks...

And to think all this is inside
a colony ship...

You forget that when you live here,
don't you?

Well, let's head back.
The wind's picking up, too...

(I came to Griffith Park with
Yamashiro-sensei today.)
It's my favorite place.

It's always nice here,
whenever you come...

It's so calming.
The breeze feels nice, too.
Shall we walk around here for a while?

Getting in touch with nature regularly
isn't half bad.

Maybe I'll try growing a houseplant
or something.
...Just don't let it die on you.

Well, let's head back.
It's gotten quite cold.

(I'm at the artificial island with
Yamashiro-sensei today.)

Took you long enough, \p.
I got tired of waiting.

S-sorry...
Something took me longer than expected...

Let's skip the beach today
and explore a bit.

Hm, so there are plenty of places
to pass the time besides the beach.
It's an island built for leisure, after all.

True enough.
I don't come here often,
so it all felt new to me.
Me too!
Well then, let's head home.

(I'm at the artificial island with
Yamashiro-sensei today.)
Same here!

For now, let's skip the beach and explore
a bit today. That area around the cliff
has caught my interest.

So that cliff is used as
a movie location.
Looks like it.

It's dangerous to go in there,
so be careful.

Don't worry.
I only ever come here to swim.

Then that's fine.
Shall we head home?

(I'm going to Deep Akihabara with
Yamashiro-sensei today!)

Sorry I'm late,
\p.

I just got here too,
so it's totally fine.

I see. Then I'm sorry, but bear with me.
There's something I can only find here.

Too bad. It was the Complete VF Collection
you were looking for, right?

Ngh... If I can't find it even here...
I may have no choice but to go
to another fleet...
What! Seriously!?

That's just how determined I am...
Sorry, but let's call it a day.
(Yamashiro-sensei looks really down...)

(I'm going to Deep Akihabara with
Yamashiro-sensei today.)

I just got here too,
so don't worry about it at all.

(I'm going to Deep Akihabara with
Yamashiro-sensei again today!)
I just got here too.

I've gathered all sorts of information
on the shops... Today looks promising.
No luck again today, huh...

Ngh... If I can't find it even here...
Is it hopeless...?
Come on, don't be so down...

No... It's fine...
Sorry, but let's go home for today.

(I'm going to Deep Akihabara with
Yamashiro-sensei again today.)
I just got here myself.
Please don't be so down...

uncertain: c06674/c06683/c06685/c06692 use Deep Akihabara, which is 'provisional' in locations.json.
c06675 'Sorry I'm late, \p.' is shared with Kagura (frd_kgr_102).
c06657/c06666 also open frd_itk_116; matched slice 92's c06806/c06813 wording ('I'm at the artificial island with Yamashiro-sensei...').
c06658: 'osokatta na' rendered 'Took you long enough', as c06580 in slice 89; 'machikutabireta' as slice 92's 'I got tired of waiting'.
c06678: the VF set Yamashiro seeks is the 'Complete VF Collection' as in c06404 (slice 86; that branch has him already finding it, this one has not).
c06663: 'shinsen na kibun' rendered 'it all felt new to me' to keep clear of the glossary 'refresh' gag term.
